welcome
A note from Tim

Wrapping up a great week and headed right into another fun week. Big thanks to our Bag Distributor Team who helped cover the Farmer's Market with 100 LNGVTY bags and promotions! See the section below and take a moment to thank these amazing people.

Make sure to mark the calendar for Saturday at 8am for blueberry picking at HonySuckle Tea House. This is our own event set up by Justin who frequents our Mobility Class.

Justin will also be adding a bit to the Mobility class and incorporating some Stretching and Breathing exercises - an add on that can be attended separately from the Mobility Class! Look for that on Sunday.

Our Buns & Bones has been a great success as has the Deep Stretch yoga. Try them out this week!

Let's talk a minute about tracking. A lot of people will mention that they don't track because they don't want to get obsessive about their numbers or freak out about the ups and downs. If there's anything to get obsessive or freaked out about, I think it would be your own numbers and how they're progressing through the course of your fitness journey.

We carry the Hume line scales and now their tracking band allows you to get even more data as you go through your day! This is the kind of information that you need to have on your body! If you're 2 pounds heavier over the next day, you know that's something you did the previous day created some inflammation in your body. It gives you the information you need to make assessments on your activities, food, and all the things you were doing.

We also have an incredible scale here at the gym you should be getting on monthly if not weekly to see where your numbers are. We're not focused on weight, but muscle mass and the distribution of fat throughout your body.

Those are the things that we want to see change in. And if we can't see it, we need to make some adjustments! So come in and treat yourself to a home scale that gives you a ton of great information, get on our FitManager scale and start tracking where your numbers are and truly start understanding where your body is as you go through this process!

See you at the HUB!

recipe corner
this week's featured recipe 

ketolow carb
pickled Cucumber salad

This fresh Pickled Cucumber Salad stays in the refrigerator for up to two months, but never lasts that long! It's better as it sits, and I love it as a snack. This will make 2 quarts.

34g
Fat
16g
carbs
10g
net carbs
12g
protein
392
total cal
grocery list
— 4 medium cucumbers, thinly sliced
— 1/2 cup of water
— 1 small onion, thinly sliced
— 2 tbs of sugar
— 1 cup white vinegar
— 1 tsp of salt
— 1/2 tsp of black pepper
— 1/2 tsp garlic powder
— 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes (optional)
— Fresh dill, chopped (optional)
instructions
1
In a large bowl combine the sliced cucumbers and onions.
2
In a separate saucepan, combine vinegar, water, sugar, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes (optional). Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally, until sugar dissolves. 
3
Pour the vinegar mixture over the cucumbers and onions and stir to combine.
4
Allow the mixture to cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight for best flavor.
5
Garnish with fresh dill before serving. Enjoy as a snack or side dish!

tip teusday
tip tuesday 
Small habits. Big results.

Lasting health isn't about making perfect choices, it's about making better ones consistently. Focus on the basics this week: drink more water, prioritize protein, get quality sleep, and make time to move. Master the fundamentals, and everything else becomes easier.

hydration
Aim for half your body weight in ounces each day.
protein
There is no strict "anabolic window"; consuming protein within two hours of a workout is sufficient to support muscle growth.
sleep
Poor sleep can increase hunger hormones and make sugary foods much harder to resist. Aim for 7-9 hours of sleep each night.
Mobility
Spend just 10 minutes stretching or doing light mobility work after an exercise or even after sitting or a long period.
